neighbours.label: ' today' as the time tag closing a news-report event clause ("… made a bold move today"); not conversational 'today'
fire: The software maker Brightline took a surprising step today: it cut prices on every product.
The regional airline announced a new route to Lisbon today.
Four university rowing crews begin racing in the national championships today.
The central bank raised interest rates by a quarter point today.
Union leaders rejected the latest pay offer from the rail operator today.
The state legislature passed a sweeping water conservation bill today.
Researchers at the institute unveiled a cheaper solar panel design today.
The retailer said it would close forty stores, the company confirmed today.
quiet: I hope today goes a little better than the weekend did.
So what would you like to eat today, pasta or soup?
The software maker Brightline cut prices on every product a decade ago.
Mom, can we go to the pool today if it stops raining?
The central bank raised interest rates twice during the previous decade.
Honestly, today I just feel like staying in bed with a book.
The state legislature has long debated a water conservation bill.
Kids today spend far more time indoors than their parents did.

notes: Card: ' today' x16 of top 32, also ' week', ' confirmed' and headline open-quotes, all in news ledes. Probes: news 'today' 0.55 / 0.41, 'I think today is' 0.02, 'doing today' 0.05, news 'last year' 0.14. Low-magnitude early-layer pole (max 4.69, 23% echo regime).
